content: Jesus Thuneina Ki Dong

Jesus kungah, hong son tan, hibang te bang thuneina taw vawt ni ziam? a hibale hi thuneina kua in hong pia ziam? ci uh hi.
Jesus in zo kik a,

content.text: Kei zong thu khat hong dong tu khi hi; hong zo tavun:
Tuiphumpa John sia, van pan ziam maw, mihing te kung pan ziam?

content: ci hi.
Amate ngaisun khawm tek uh a, van pan hi; ci leang, ama in, banghang um ngawl nu ziam? hong ci tu.
A hi tazong, mihing te kung pan hi; ci leang zong, mihing te in suangtum taw hong sep tu hi: banghangziam cile amate in John sia kamsang hi, ci um uh hi.
Taciang amate in, koisung pan, ci hong son thei ngawl khu hi, ci in zo uh hi.
Jesus in amate tung ah,

content.text: Kei zong hi te bang thuneina taw vawt, ci sia hong son ngawl tu khi hi,

Sapit Huan Naseamte Sontena
Tuazawkciang Jesus in mipi te hi sontena son hi;

content.text: Mi khat in sapit huan sungah sapit suan a, huan naseam te thosak hi, taciang ama sia a ngei mama om tu in khual khuala ah haw hi.
A hun a cin ciang in, huan naseam te in sapit huan sungah a nga te a piak tu in, a naseam khat sawl hi: ahihang huan naseam te in a naseam pa vel uh a, a khut hawm taw tha kik hi.
Taciang naseam dang khat sawl kik leleau a, tua pa zong vel leleau hi, taciang maizumhuai tak in koi uh a, khut hawm nguak ma tha kik uh hi.
A thum na sawl kik leleau hi: taciang amate in liamsak uh a, doi pua sangah nawt uh hi.
Tuazawkciang in sapit huan nei pa in, bangbang hi tu khi ziam? Ka it ka tapa sawl a hileng, amate in a mu uh ciang zakta tu uh hi, ci hi.
Ahihang huan naseam te in a mu uh ciang in, kikum uh a, hi sia pa sia a ngamhlua tu pa hi: pai tavun, that tawng, taciang a ngamh teng i lua tu hi, ci uh hi.
Taciang amate in sapit huan puasang ah pusuapui in that uh hi. Tua ahikom huan neipa in amate tungah bang vawt tu ziam?
Ama hongpai tu a hi teng that in a sapit huan sia ngual dang pia tu hi,

content: ci hi.
Jesus in amate en a,

content.text: Innsa te i a nil uh suangtum sia innkhuambul hong suak hi, ci a ki atkhol thu sia bang ziam?
A kuamapo hi suang tungah a tak peuma tal tu hi, ahizong hi suang a takna te sia a vui in ki ngoai siat tu hi,

content: ci hi.
Caesar Tung Sia Piakna Thu
Tua hun laitak in thiampi lian te le thukhamhil te in Jesus mat tu in zong hi; banghangziam cile hi thu sontena sia amate langpan in kampau hi, ci he uh hi, taciang amate in mipi te lau hi.
Amate in Jesus pang uh a, thukan te paisak uh hi, tua thukan te sia mipha bang in ki hitheamsak a, ama kammal pan in mat tu le ngam uk za nei ulian te ap tu in sawm uh hi.
Thukan te in, Syapa awng, a man tatak in hil le kampau ci kong he uh hi, kuama doidan zong nei ngawl ni hi, Pathian i lampi sia a mantak in na hil hi:
Caesar shia pia tu khu ziam maw, pia ngawl tu khu ziam? ci in dong uh.
Ahihang Jesus in amate thin kukal na he a,

content.text: Banghang hong ze-et nu ziam?
Sum tang hong lak tavun. A kua i lim le ceptena ziam?

content: ci hi. Amate in Caesar lim le ceptena hi, ci in zo uh hi.
Taciang Jesus in amate tung ah,

content.text: Caesar neisa te Caesar pia vun a, Pathian neisa te Pathian pia vun,

content: ci hi.
Mipi te mai ah a kammal te pan in a man thei bua uh hi: a zo kik nate lamdangsa uh a, huthe ngawl in om tek uh hi.
Thawkikna Thu
Thawkikna a nial Sadducee pawlkhat te Jesus kungah hongpai uh a,
Sya awng, mi khatpo sia ta nei ngawl in a thi le, a ci mit ngawl natu in a nau in a mo tenpui tahen, ci Moses in at hi.
Tua ahikom u nau sali om uh hi: a lianbel sia in zi nei a, ta nei ngawl in thi hi.
A ni na pa in tua nu tenpui a, ta nei ngawl ma in thi hi.
A thum na pa zong in tua nu tenpui hi; tabangma in a sali in tenpui uh a, ta nei ngawl in thi siat uh hi.
A khakbel ciang tua nu zong thi hi.
Tua ahikom thawkik na ni ciang tua nu sia a kua bel i zi hi tu ziam? banghangziam cile a sali in tenpui hi, ci in dong uh hi.
Jesus in amate tung ah,

content.text: Hi leitung mite kipui uh a, nupa tu in ki pia uh hi:
Ahihang tua leitang lua tu kilawm ci in ngaisut te le thina pan a thokik te sia kipui le nupa tu in ki piak om nawn ngawl tu hi.
Amate sia thi thei nawn ngawl tu uh hi: banghangziam cile amate sia vantungmi te bang hi tu uh a, thawkikna i tate a hi uh man in Pathian i tate a hihi.
Tu in mithi te thokik hi, ci Moses zong in lophung sungah topa, Abraham Pathian, Isaac Pathian le Jacob Pathian, a sap ciang in mu hi.
Banghangziam cile Pathian sia mithi te Pathian hi ngawl hi, ahihang a nungta te i Pathian a hihi: banghangziam cile mi theampo ama sungah a nungta te vive a hihi,

content: ci in zo kik hi.
Thukhamhil pawlkhat te in, Syapa awng, na pau na pha mama hi, ci tek uh hi.
Tuazawkciang amate in thudong ngam nawn ngawl hi.
Christ Sia Kua Tapa Ziam?
Jesus in amate tung ah,

content.text: Bangbang in mihing te in Christ sia David tapa hi, ci thei uh ziam?
David ama mama in Psalm labu sungah, Topa in ka Topa tung ah,
Na ngalte na peang koi na in na vawt mateng, ka ziatsang ah to in.
Tua ahikom David in Topa, ci in sam hi, bangbang in a tapa hi thei tu ziam?

content: ci hi.
Thukhamhil te Kidawm Vun
Tuazawkciang in thu ngai te theampo i zak in a nungzui te tung ah,

content.text: Thuakhamhil te kidawm vun, amate sia puan tualpi sil in vak nuam uh a, sumbuk te ah paupuina, synagogue sungah tokhum sangbel te le poai mun ah a inndoi lianbel te dei uh hi;
Amate in meingong te inn suttol uh a, ngual mu tu in thu sau tatak ngen uh hi: tabang te in a lianzaw danpiak na thuak tu uh hi,
